caregiver.title: Third caregiver
caregiver.intro: Adjusted Brief CRS; a Who Does What column for their tasks; PSDQ if they take real caregiving time. Then four questions.

questions.text: What help do you want from the household?
What help are you able to give?
What role would you like with the child?
What would you prefer the household not do?

child.title: Child (kitchen-table conversation, adults present, never a form)
child.intro: A guided shared-screen script that an adult runs with the child present. Answers are typed by the adult and stored under a child_proxy role. The adults answer the two rule questions as well, and those are pinned to the plan.

questions.text: What makes home feel safe and good to you?
When a grown-up is upset about something, how do you like them to tell you?
What's something you'd like to do with each grown-up, just the two of you?
What's a house rule you think is fair? What's one you think isn't?
When you have a question about something a grown-up does, what should you do?
What should a grown-up do if you say something and they don't like it?
What do you want a new baby to know about you?
